```python
from pocket_coffea.lib.cuts import MultiCut, CartesianProduct

# Jet multiplicity binning: exactly 4, exactly 5, at least 6 jets of JetGood
jet_multiplicity = MultiCut(
    "njets",
    {
        "4j": (4, 4),      # exactly 4 jets
        "5j": (5, 5),      # exactly 5 jets
        "6j": (6, None),   # 6 or more jets
    }
)

# B-tag multiplicity binning: exactly 2, at least 3 b-jets
btag_multiplicity = MultiCut(
    "nbtags",
    {
        "2b": (2, 2),      # exactly 2 b-tags
        "3b": (3, None),   # 3 or more b-tags
    }
)

# Create cartesian product of the two binnings
analysis_categories = CartesianProduct(
    [jet_multiplicity, btag_multiplicity]
)
```
